body:
IT'S HERE 🩷 Today Taylor didn't just drop a new single — she opened a whole new door. 'Patient Zero' is out as a single, and it turns out to be the lead of something bigger: The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore.

The Encore expands last year's album with four new tracks — 'Patient Zero,' 'Cleveland!,' 'Pink Clouding' and 'Babylon' — landing as tracks 13 through 16. She teased the whole thing for two weeks by swapping every O in her bios for a zero, and the group chats have not recovered since.

We already keep the entire Showgirl era mapped on the site — the announcement, a song-by-song guide, every milestone with a citation — and today it got four brand-new chapters to grow into.

Which of the four are you playing first? Tag the friend you're already texting about it 🩷

The tour photo is decorative (no Showgirl photo exists), but timeliness carries it. Sourced to major outlets.
